summary: Fixed critical "toolCall" format mismatch bug in both convention-check.ts and evaluate-sessions.ts. Both handlers were checking for "tool_use"/"tool_call" but JSONL uses "toolCall" with "arguments" (not "input"). Also fixed false-positive error detection using explicit isError field.

decisions: Use toolCall type detection alongside tool_use for forward compat
Use isError field for error detection, with pattern-matching fallback for old formats
Kept tool_use detection for backward compat
bugs_fixed: convention-check.ts: block.type check missed toolCall, block.input should be block.arguments
evaluate-sessions.ts: block.type check missed toolCall, tool result role check missed toolResult
evaluate-sessions.ts: error detection used 'error' substring which had massive false positives
